decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Plan 2, Unnumbered floor plan, Design and Access Statement, Heritage and Planning Statement. Received: 01/11/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The re-wiring and fitting of new light fittings shall make use of existing service channels in the fabric and no new service channels shall be chased into historic fabric.
description: Refurbishment and redecoration of internal room  (Listed building consent).
